text:
tara: Heads-up: canary for kestrel-int4 is showing a new failure mode in streaming funcalls  trailing commas and occasional stray nulls inside arrays causing our strict JSON validator to blow up. non-stream and int8/fp16 are fine.

benji: how bad? numbers? which templates?

tara: parse_fail jumped 0.08% -> 2.3% on int4 pool (5k queries). affects templates that return arrays of action objects (3 templates).

orma: paste an exact reassembled stream that failed

tara: ```
{
  "actions": [
    {"op": "set", "k": "x", "v": 1},
  ],
  "meta": {"id": "r-12"}
}
```

tara: note the trailing comma after the last element. in other cases we saw: `"v":1}, null ]` inserted before close.

nora: is the null coming from the model or our telemetry layer?

test-bot: CI: flagged recent PR 2101 touching tokenizer merge heuristics as potential covariate.

orma: hypothesis: int4 tokenization and stop-token probs shift chunk boundaries so the closing bracket/comma can be split across chunks; if prefix-trim or chunk reordering occurs we can end up with dangling separators. the model sometimes emits an extra `null` token as a cheap filler when it sees a partial array end.

benji: short-term mitigation idea: tolerant pre-parse pass that: 1) removes trailing commas at top-level array/object boundaries, and 2) drops immediate top-level `null` elements adjacent to separators when schema forbids nulls. mark as repaired and record semantic-eq vs gold.

tara: implemented a small sanitizer prototype and reran canary: parse_fail dropped to 0.42% on int4. still above baseline but much improved.

nora: we must be careful not to silence legitimate nulls. only apply the null-drop when the schema for that route marks items as non-nullable. add a strict-vs-tolerant metric to EVAL harness so we can track repairs and false positives.

orma: rollout plan: A) enable sanitizer in int4 streaming canary only, B) enable token-offset and chunk-seq debug logs, C) run 48h and require repaired<=0.5% and false_repair_rate<0.02% before promoting.

devops: scheduling the canary patch at 02:15 UTC and will post deploy status.

benji: long-term fixes: token-level stitching in reassembler and model-side vocab/decoder tweak so punctuation + brackets are not split (MODEL-678). opened MODEL-678.

tara: created runtime ticket RUNTIME-801 and eval ticket EVAL-2440; links posted in thread.

nora: also add an opt-out in SDK parse helper so private deployments can keep strict parsing if needed.

tara: good catch. I'll share a 12h metrics snapshot here. thanks all :thumbsup: 

benji: please attach a couple of token-diff samples so the model team can repro deterministically.

tara: will do. end of thread.
